title: Bismuth
description: &6Bismuth&r is an important material needed in many advanced crafting recipes. Bismuth can be obtained from either &3RBMK&r fuel depletion and processing though a &3FEL&r and &3SILEX&r, or from bedrock ore processing using &bHigh-Performance Solvent&r.
&6Arsenic&r will require an additional &bOre Acidizer&r aswell as access to high-performance solvent.
